name: reticula-format-vectors
description: Golden vectors for Reticula note format v0 (docs/format.md). Every 'expected' value must be reproduced bit for bit by an implementation. Seeds are PUBLIC TEST VALUES, never use them for real keys.

conventions.ed25519: RFC 8032 pure Ed25519; 'seed_hex' is the 32-byte private seed; signatures are 64 raw bytes
conventions.canonical_json: UTF-8, keys sorted by code point, separators ',' ':' , no whitespace, non-ASCII emitted raw, no floats/NaN
conventions.uuid7: 48-bit big-endian ms timestamp | 0x7 | rand_a(12) | 0b10 | rand_b(62); random_hex is 10 bytes: rand_a = low nibble of byte0 + byte1, rand_b = low 6 bits of byte2 + bytes 3..9
conventions.content_hash: 'sha256:' + hex(sha256(salt_bytes + utf8(payload string)))  (salt_bytes empty while salt is 'none')
conventions.record_inputs: 'inputs' are the arguments of build_envelope (plus 'extra' = unknown fields added to the envelope); 'payload' is an object serialised canonically into the envelope's 'payload' string
